SETTLE INTO YOUR OWN SPACE

Four stays.
One coastal state of mind.

For early launches, unhurried days and everything in between. Pick your base, unpack your bags, and make yourself at home.

01 / PEARL

Pearl

Light & easy

Bright, calm and completely your own. A comfortable base for one or two, with everything you need for an easy self-catering stay.

Check availability ↗
02 / CORAL

Coral

Warm & welcoming

A private little retreat with warm tones, close to the communal braai area. Made for couples or two riders sharing an adventure.

Check availability ↗
03 / SWELL

Swell

Room for the ride

Our largest unit, with space for boards, bars and wetsuits to dry. A practical home base for kitesurfers travelling with gear.

Check availability ↗
04 / KELP

Kelp

Your quiet corner

Tucked at the back of the property, with garden views and a little more quiet. A slower pace when you're off the water.

FOLLOW THE SOUTH EASTER

Others, for the wind.

At Seajax, you don't have to choose. Blouberg Beach and Kite Beach are a short walk away, with the Cape Doctor setting the rhythm of summer.
